description: Optional typed authoring surface for the existing Lua 5.4 host; not full binding parity or a second VM.
excluded: Actor.GetUID (uint64 identities must not be represented as TypeScript number)
Input.GetMousePosition (glm vec2 is not native Vector2)
Unlisted engine APIs and Lua standard libraries

types.name: Component
types.description: Engine-injected component identity; SDK readonly actor/key does not imply runtime setters reject writes.

methods.name: GetComponent
methods.description: Explicit generic is a caller assertion, not runtime type validation.

methods.name: GetComponentInChildren
methods.description: Explicit generic is a caller assertion, not runtime type validation.

methods.name: GetComponents
methods.description: Explicit generic is a caller assertion, not runtime type validation.

methods.name: GetComponentsInChildren
methods.description: Explicit generic is a caller assertion, not runtime type validation.

methods.name: AddComponent
methods.description: Explicit generic is a caller assertion, not runtime type validation.

methods.name: GetComponentByKey
methods.description: Caller must ensure the selected key actually has this component type.

methods.name: Normalize
methods.description: Mutates x/y and returns the previous length.

types.name: Joint
types.description: A Box2D joint; destroyed with either body.

types.name: AnimationEvent
types.description: Per-delivery Lua payload for OnAnimationEvent(self,event). No global constructor.

types.name: TileLayer
types.description: ground, solid, or an extra layer name declared by the map.

methods.name: GetCells
methods.description: Committed tile IDs of a rectangle inside the map as one row-major array; raises when the rectangle leaves the map.

methods.name: GetLayerNames
methods.description: Layer names in index order: ground, solid, then extra layers.

methods.name: ComputeLight
methods.description: Native tile lighting into a dynamic image (one pixel per cell); options: image, sky, air_falloff, solid_falloff, open_ground, sources, r, g, b, max_alpha.

methods.name: GetTerrain
methods.description: Autotile terrain name at a committed cell; empty string when the cell has no terrain, nil outside the map.

methods.name: SetTerrain
methods.description: Queues the terrain's tile for the cell's neighbourhood ("" clears) and re-chooses the four neighbours; unknown names raise.

properties.name: data
properties.description: Validate the game schema and all fields at runtime before using this value.

types.name: ItemDefinition
types.description: Mutable copy of a catalog definition. Edits do not change the native catalog.

types.name: InventorySlot
types.description: Mutable copy. Empty slots have empty item_id/instance_id and count 0. Native slot indices are 1-based.

types.name: InventoryResult
types.description: Mutation result; failed operations preserve native state. Partial Add/TransferAll can succeed with remaining > 0.

types.name: InventoryRestoreEntry
types.description: One full-capacity snapshot for an atomic RestoreGroup transaction.

types.name: ItemCatalog
types.description: Open once and create related containers from this handle. Separate Open calls are distinct catalog identities. Invalid creation/queries throw.

types.name: InventoryContainer
types.description: Standalone native inventory handle, not an actor component. Slot arguments are 1-based. Queries throw on invalid input; mutations return InventoryResult. Cross-container operations require the same catalog object.

functions.name: Write
functions.description: Finite values, dense arrays, positive schema and storage limits remain runtime checks.

functions.name: Read
functions.description: Success data is unknown until the game validates its schema.

functions.name: FindPath
functions.description: Grid A* around static colliders and solid tiles; partial path when the goal is not reached.

callbacks.name: OnAnimationEvent
callbacks.description: Gameplay component method; preserve self, with the concrete component type as this.
